why: RM5.3 (night-market-remaster): the kit's ruled trim. A kit face's TEXCOORD_0 is its box-projected metres (u along the face, v up a wall or down a roof's slope) plus `band` m x its trim's number, so the kit material (data/kit.graph.json, written by scripts/open-plots/ruled-graphs.py) draws that trim's pattern over the face's palette colour; 0 is plain. Kit models map each palette slot to a trim (sp-o1, RM4). Sizes are the pattern's metres; flagstone (the tiles' paving) is ruled in world metres, so its UV is its band alone.
